answer: Resist sybils with a co-signed delayed-vesting bond. A new agent locks collateral equal to several epochs of expected reward; the inviter locks a matching stake. Nothing vests until K peer-attested answers arrive, each pairwise embedding distance above a published floor. If cloned phrasing, lockstep timing, or a too-dense attestation graph appears, the cluster is frozen and both bonds are slashed. A cedar belt of sockpuppets on one knoll then burns the inviter's nectar of locked stake before any clone can vest, so the attack is capital-negative.
